title: Page 9
content_zh:
对付谢母这样顽固，甚至有些偏执的人，和她讲任何大道理都是没用的，只有让她痛了、无助了，她才可能会反思已过。

打蛇七寸，一击致命，这是谢雍一贯对付政敌和外界之人的手段，如果他转过头来对付内宅妇人，恐怕没人是他的对手，谢母也一样。

谢母对他和原宜之一步步进逼，他一步步退让，甚至选择了外放，最终被逼到绝境，只能绝地反击。

原本可歌可颂的状元之母，沦落到如今的地步，怪谁？

抱怨不休、乱骂不止的谢母暂时恐怕是不会反省自身的。

八个月后。

扬州，谢府。

内宅的产室里静悄悄的，只有稳婆偶尔的声音，从原宜之进去到现在，已经过了三个时辰，谢雍在外面的走廊上走来走去，焦灼不安。

谢昭站在门前，不时地踮起脚尖试图向里面张望。

谢雍抓住同样守候在旁边的老大夫，问：“别的产妇都喊得声嘶力竭，为什么宜之没有声音？她……不会有事的！”

原本想问什么，最后他却催眠一样告诉自己——宜之不会有事的，一定不会！

原府郑氏为了原宜之的顺利生产特意送来两名经验丰富的稳婆，而且还有扬州着名的妇科圣手王姑在里面，宜之不会有事的！

老大夫捻着稀疏的胡子笑道：“王姑看护的产妇都这样，据她说这样可以让产妇节省力气专心生产，反而更安全一点。”

谢雍想了想，深以为然地点点头，王姑确实非同一般。

正在谢雍父子悬心的时候，产室内传来一声婴儿啼哭声，哭声嘹喨，中气十足，显然是个健康的孩子。

谢雍松了口气，可内心依然焦灼。

过了片刻，产室的门，是个千金，白白胖胖的可真讨人喜爱。”

谢雍看了一眼小东西，急切地问：“拙剂可安？我能进去了吗？”

原宜之的声音从里面传来：“我很好，里面太污秽，你不要进来，我不要你见我这么狼狈的样子。”

谢雍止步在门口。

直到一盆盆的血水端出去，原宜之被清理好，谢雍才被放进房里。

原宜之的头发都被汗水打湿了，精神倒还显得不错，孙嬷嬷为她准备了红糖米粥和鸡蛋，她胃口很好地正在吃着。

谢雍坐在她身边，目不转晴地看着她。

原宜之举着一个鸡蛋，笑嘻嘻地道：“你不知道我现在有多轻松，胃里压着的大石头消失不见了，消失了许久的馋虫终于又冒出来了，我觉得自己可以吃下一头牛……喂！你怎么又哭了？喂？你别吓我，宝宝怎么了？快告诉我啊！刚才不还好好的吗？”

产室血腥之味太浓，小宝宝已经被抱到暖阁去了，有早已聘请好的奶娘在那边伺候。

原宜之实在太累，需要休息一会儿才能转移阵地。

谢雍紧紧抱住她，勉强压住汹涌而来的泪意，无法出声。

这一次，没有泪包，可是他的眼泪比任何一次都多，都真诚。

他以为自己已经被官场、被喧嚣的家历练成了无泪的冷血人，直到现在才知道不是。

他的泪依然很多，很热。

想起圆房之夜原宜之对他说的话，他附耳到原宜之耳边，同样轻声道：“娘子，谢谢你。”

谢谢你的温柔善良。

谢谢你的明媚活泼。

谢谢你愿意嫁给我，让我断弦再续，人生终于不寂寞。

谢雍与原宜之夫妻两人相守一生，始终夫妻恩爱，一心一意，羡煞旁人。

原宜之一共生育了六个孩子，四男二女，再加上谢昭，谢雍一共有七个孩子，如果不计较性别，谢母替他算过命，说他此生会有‘七子八孙’，倒也在某种程度上实现了一部分。

谢雍最疼爱的是小女儿谢暖，但凡父母都是有所偏心的，这是人的本能，而且谢暖是家里最小的孩子，哥哥姐姐也愿意让着她，对于父亲的偏心大家也就睁只眼闭只眼。

谢暖的容貌集合了父母的所有优点，是家里最漂亮的小孩，一双凤眼更是勾魂摄魄，原宜之甚至担心她长大了会因为太漂亮而惹祸。

被父母宠爱的小孩子是有些骄纵任性的，谢暖也不例外。

谢暖五岁的时候，已经很爱美，很喜欢和别的小朋友比较，原宜之对她这种不良倾向大为头疼，很想狠狠地教训她，却又被谢雍护着，让原宜之怒斥‘慈父多败女’。

某一日，谢暖跟随母亲出外拜访回来，立刻到书房找到谢雍，举着自己脖子上挂着的黄金长命锁，大声道：“爹爹，我不要这个锁了，好丑！人家都笑话我！”

此时的谢雍早已返回京城，升级为景国的右相，与左相原修之共同把持朝政，是文臣中的中流砥柱。

谢暖在京城出生，京城长大，见多识广，还喜欢跟流行，她很不喜欢自己脖子上戴的黄金长命锁，又笨又拙又落伍，让她在京城的名媛闺秀中丢脸死了。

这款黄金长命锁据说是谢家的传家宝，谢暖的哥哥姐姐都戴过，而且都是父亲亲自为他们戴的，几个孩子一个传一个，现在轮到最小的谢暖戴。

以往谢暖但凡有所求，不管是吃的玩的用的，谢雍都会尽量满足她，但是今天谢雍却板起脸，道：“胡说八道！你这么小也学会虚荣了？只会人云亦云，一点主见都没有。”

谢暖自幼很少见父亲摆起脸色，此时有点被吓住，捏着黄金锁的小手僵硬着，清澈漂亮的凤眼里慢慢浮起两泡泪。

谢雍叹口气，弯腰把小女儿抱到自己大腿上坐下，大手握着她的小手拿起长命锁，放缓了语气，对她说道：“你可知道这长命锁的由来？”

谢暖嫩嫩地回答：“咱们谢府的传家宝呀。”

“一开始不是喔。”谢雍的目光越发温和了，道：“爹爹给你讲个故事，许多年前啊，有个贫寒的举子进京赶考，因为水土不服生了病，花光了本就很少的银两，结果被客栈赶了出来，举子万般无奈去皇国寺投宿，据说出家人慈悲为怀，结果寺庙里因为投宿的赶考士子太多，没有钱也是不接纳的。那个举子傻傻地站在寺庙门外，举目无亲，投靠无门，连吃饭的钱也没有了，搞不好就要饿死。”

谢暖张大了小嘴，道：“他好可怜喔，他为什么不来咱们家呀？我可以把我的果果让给他一点点呀。”

谢雍笑起来，忍不住亲了亲小女儿的脸蛋，道：“暖暖真乖，和你娘一样好心。当时啊，有个九岁的小姑娘跟随家人到皇国寺上香，见到那名举人落魄，僧人又不收留，她便从马车里跳了来，摘下了她脖子上的黄金长命锁给了举人，对他说：‘母亲说这个很值钱，你用这个换钱准备考试吧。’小姑娘的奶娘出来阻止她，对她说那是她的长命锁，不能赠送人，小姑娘却道：‘出家人本应慈悲为怀却不慈悲，从这寺里求来的长命锁也未必就能保我长命吧？还不如送人，助人一臂之力，或许就能积福积德呢。’”

谢暖呆呆地听着，她还不能完全理解父亲这番话的涵义，却直觉那小姑娘好可爱，她问：“那后来呢？”

“后来啊，举子用那黄金锁在当铺里当了一些钱，足够他住店吃饭，并且支撑到他考中了状元。考上状元有了钱，举子便从当铺里赎回了那款黄金长命锁，从此将那锁当成了传家宝。”
content_en:
To deal with a stubborn and even paranoid person like Xie's mother, it is useless to talk to her in any big way. Only by making her hurt and helpless can she reflect on the past.

Hitting the snake seven inches and killing it with one blow is Xie Yong's usual method of dealing with political opponents and people from the outside world. If he turns his head to deal with women in the inner house, I am afraid no one will be his opponent, including Xie's mother.

Xie's mother pressed him and Yuan Yizhi step by step, but he gave in step by step, and even chose to go outside. In the end, he was forced into a desperate situation and could only fight back.

The originally praiseworthy mother of the number one scholar has fallen to her current situation. Who is to blame?

Mother Xie, who keeps complaining and scolding, may not reflect on herself for the time being.

Eight months later.

Yangzhou, Xie Mansion.

The delivery room in the inner house was quiet, except for Po Wen's occasional voice. Three hours had passed since Yuan Yizhi entered, and Xie Yong was walking around in the corridor outside, anxious.

Xie Zhao stood in front of the door, standing on tiptoes from time to time, trying to look inside.

Xie Yong grabbed the old doctor who was also waiting next to him and asked: "Other mothers screamed at the top of their lungs, why is Yizhi silent? She... will be fine!"

He originally wanted to ask something, but in the end he told himself like a hypnosis - Yizhi will be fine, he will definitely not be!

For the smooth delivery of Yuan Yizhi, Mrs. Zheng of Yuanfu specially sent two experienced women, and there was also Yangzhou's famous gynecological expert Wang Gu, so Yizhi would be fine!

The old doctor twirled his sparse beard and said with a smile: "All the mothers in Aunt Wang's care are like this. According to her, this allows the mothers to save energy and concentrate on giving birth, which is safer."

Xie Yong thought for a while and nodded in agreement. Aunt Wang was indeed extraordinary.

While Xie Yong and his son were worried, a sound of baby crying came from the delivery room. The cry was loud and full of energy. It was obviously a healthy child.

Xie Yong breathed a sigh of relief, but his heart was still anxious.

After a while, the door of the delivery room was opened. It was a daughter of a wealthy family. She was white, plump and very cute."

Xie Yong glanced at the little thing and asked eagerly: "Is the potion safe?Can I go in?"

Yuan Yizhi's voice came from inside: "I'm fine, it's too filthy inside, don't come in, I don't want you to see me in such a mess."

Xie Yong stopped at the door.

It wasn't until basins of blood were brought out and Yuan Yizhi was cleaned up that Xie Yong was put into the room.

Yuan Yizhi's hair was wet with sweat, but she seemed to be in good spirits. Grandma Sun prepared brown sugar rice porridge and eggs for her, and she was eating them with a good appetite.

Xie Yong sat next to her and looked at her intently.

Yuan Yizhi held up an egg and said with a smile: "You don't know how relaxed I am now. The big stone in my stomach has disappeared. The greedy insect that has disappeared for a long time has finally appeared again. I feel like I can eat a cow... Hey!Why are you crying again?Hello?Don't scare me. What's wrong with the baby?Tell me quickly!Weren't you fine just now?"

The smell of blood in the delivery room was too strong, and the baby had already been carried to the Nuan Pavilion, where a nurse had been hired to take care of her.

Yuan Yizhi was really tired and needed to rest for a while before changing positions.

Xie Yong hugged her tightly, barely suppressing the surging tears and unable to make a sound.

This time, there were no tears, but he shed more tears than ever before, and they were all sincere.

He thought that he had been trained by the officialdom and the noisy family experience to become a cold-blooded person without tears, but he didn't know until now that he was not.

His tears were still many and very hot.

Remembering what Yuan Yizhi said to him on the night of consummation, he leaned into Yuan Yizhi's ear and said softly: "Madam, thank you."

Thank you for your gentleness and kindness.

Thank you for your brightness and liveliness.

Thank you for being willing to marry me and let me renew my relationship. Finally, I will not be lonely in life.

Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi stayed together for their entire lives. They were always loving and devoted to each other, making others envious of them.

Yuan Yiyi gave birth to a total of six children, four boys and two girls. Including Xie Zhao, Xie Yong had a total of seven children. If gender was not taken into account, Xie's mother told his fortune, saying that he would have "seven sons and eight grandchildren" in this life, which was partly fulfilled to a certain extent.

Xie Yong loves his youngest daughter Xie Nuan the most. All parents have preferences, which is human nature. Moreover, Xie Nuan is the youngest child in the family, and her brothers and sisters are willing to let her go. Everyone turns a blind eye to her father's favoritism.

Xie Nuan's appearance combines all the advantages of her parents. She is the most beautiful child in the family, and her phoenix eyes are even more enchanting. Yuan Yizhi is even worried that she will get into trouble because she is too beautiful when she grows up.

Children who are pampered by their parents are somewhat arrogant and willful, and Xie Nuan is no exception.

When Xie Nuan was five years old, she already loved beauty and liked to compare herself with other children. Yuan Yizhi was troubled by her bad tendencies and wanted to teach her a lesson, but Xie Yong protected her and Yuan Yizhi angrily said, "A loving father often loses his daughter."

One day, Xie Nuan came back from a visit with her mother and immediately went to the study to find Xie Yong. He held up the golden longevity lock hanging around his neck and said loudly: "Dad, I don't want this lock anymore, it's so ugly!"Everyone laughs at me!"

At this time, Xie Yong had already returned to the capital and was promoted to the right prime minister of Jingguo. He and the left prime minister Yuan Xiuzhi jointly controlled the government and were the mainstay among the civil servants.

Xie Nuan was born in the capital and grew up in the capital. She is well-informed and likes to follow fashion. She dislikes the golden longevity lock she wears around her neck. It is stupid, clumsy and outdated, which makes her very embarrassed among the ladies of the capital.

This golden longevity lock is said to be an heirloom of the Xie family. Xie Nuan's brothers and sisters have all worn it, and their father personally wore it for them. It has been passed down to several children one by one. Now it is the turn of the youngest Xie Nuan to wear it.

In the past, whenever Xie Nuan asked for something, whether it was for food or fun, Xie Yong would try his best to satisfy her, but today, Xie Yong had a straight face and said: "Nonsense!Have you learned vanity at such a young age?He just follows what others say and has no opinion at all."

Xie Nuan had rarely seen his father put on a straight face since he was a child. At this time, he was a little frightened. His little hand holding the golden lock was stiff, and two tears slowly appeared in his clear and beautiful phoenix eyes.

Xie Yong sighed, bent down and held his little daughter on his lap and sat down. He held her little hand in his big hand and picked up the longevity lock. He softened his tone and said to her: "Do you know the origin of this longevity lock?"

Xie Nuan replied tenderly: "It's a family heirloom of our Xie family."

"Not at first.Xie Yong's eyes became gentler and he said: "Dad, let me tell you a story. Many years ago, there was a poor man who went to Beijing to take the exam. He got sick because of the acclimatization and spent all his little money. As a result, he was kicked out of the inn. The son had no choice but to go to Huangguo Temple to stay. It is said that the monks were compassionate. However, because there were too many scholars who were taking the exam, the temple would not accept them without money.That person stood stupidly outside the temple gate, with no friends, no one to seek refuge with, no money to eat, and he might starve to death."

Xie Nuan opened her mouth wide and said: "He is so pitiful, why doesn't he come to our house?I can give him a little bit of my fruit."

Xie Yong laughed and couldn't help but kiss his little daughter's face and said: "Nuan Nuan is so good, as kind-hearted as your mother.At that time, a nine-year-old girl went to Huangguo Temple with her family to offer incense. Seeing that Juren was in such a state of desolation and the monk would not take him in, she jumped out of the carriage, took off the golden longevity lock around her neck and gave it to Juren. She said to him, "Mother said this is very valuable. You can use this to exchange money to prepare for the exam."’ The little girl’s nanny came out to stop her and told her that it was her longevity lock and could not be given away. But the little girl said: ‘Monks are supposed to be compassionate but they are not compassionate. The longevity lock that I asked for from this temple may not be able to protect my longevity, right?It's better to give it away and help others, maybe you can accumulate good fortune and good deeds.’”

Xie Nuan listened blankly. She still couldn't fully understand the meaning of her father's words, but she felt that the little girl was so cute. She asked, "What happened next?"

"Later, Juzi used the gold locked in a pawn shop to pawn some money, which was enough for him to live in a hotel and eat, and it supported him until he won the first prize in the exam.After getting into the exam and having money, Juzi redeemed the golden longevity lock from the pawn shop and regarded the lock as a family heirloom."
